question: How does a common provisional-response realization fraction change the added requirement of the retained ERCOT reference growth path?
candidate: Retained reference national path, default geographic allocation and reference peak mapping
ordinary_response: Published ordinary response, fixed in both matched worlds
association_rule: Choose the nominal common association once per timing rule and grid position; hold it fixed across resource and realization settings
realization_rule: One effective fraction applies to the provisional credit retained in each world and every year
resource_rule: One fraction of the annual anticipated-to-prospective native resource difference applies throughout 2026-2035
scope: Conditional annual summer planning requirements, not probabilities, operational reliability or a DC-only curtailment program
current_only_distinction: Zero provisional realization retains published ordinary response and is not the current-only response scenario
